turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're still debating between a comedy and an adventure film, but either way, it'll be nice to just sit back and relax together.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Whichever one you choose, I hope you all have a fantastic and relaxing night. Let me know if you need anything else today, Marcus!
